subject: LISTING directive
notes: Rule: 'Whether the compiler produces a source listing is implementor-defined. If the compiler does not produce a source listing, the LISTING directive shall be ignored.' cite.py --check 7.3.18.3 -> OK §7.3.18.3 1). Half 1 (implementor choice): WiseOwl COBOL produces no listing — no CLI option, no producer in src; the choice is documented in docs/CONFORMANCE.md prose ('>>LISTING / >>PAGE (§7.3.18 / §7.3.19) — no source listing is produced'). Half 2 (ignored): the directive is consumed in ConditionalCompilationProcessor (operand checked against the closed ON/OFF set, ON omissible) and has no effect. Probe out/probe/listing-directive/lst{2002,2014,2023}.cob: >>LISTING OFF (twice), >>LISTING ON, bare >>LISTING, >>LISTING OFF interleaved with DATA/PROCEDURE lines; --std 2002/2014/2023 --run each prints A=1 / B=2 with no diagnostic, i.e. every line after OFF is still compiled and the directive has no effect.
